calls.reasoning: Prior from the reference class of biweekly NVDA-minus-MSFT spreads in windows with no earnings for either name: median around +1pp over 2024-26 (NVDA +34% YTD 2026 vs MSFT ~+5%), which I shrink hard toward zero because realized outperformance is not a reliable forward drift. Tilt kept slightly positive on beta differential (2.22 vs 1.11, so ~+0.3pp on a normal-drift market), post-earnings drift after NVDA's Aug 26 beat and Q3 guide of $108B, and NVDA sitting near its 52-week high while MSFT is ~10% below its own. calls.reconciliation: Disputes were (a) the vol regime, (b) the pair correlation, (c) the resulting SD, (d) tail skew, (e) NVDA YTD. (a) resolved as a non-contradiction: 45% realized includes NVDA's Aug 26 +8.7% earnings gap, 33% IV and ~37% ex-gap realized are the right inputs for an earnings-free window, so NVDA ~35%, MSFT ~26% (its 25.6% is likewise inflated by the Jul 29 +15.5% gap). (c) follows arithmetically at 5.5pp, between the runs but derived rather than averaged, and independently matched by Run 1's own measured 5.6pp over 22 non-earnings windows -- so Run 3's calm-IV 4.9 is too tight for a window carrying FOMC/SEP, Oracle's AI-capex print and quad-witching.
